description: The delegation statement vectors of the reference gateway (spec RFC 0030 §§2-3; the gateway's SPEC.md §11.1), cited, not regenerated: gateway-statements.json is that file's bytes unchanged. Its chains were signed by the gateway's independent signer under the keys it names; the expectation of each is the first refusal of steps 1 to 7, or ok. Both readers of this package check the copy's SHA-256 against this citation and read every vector to the same expectation.
